cards.title: Hugging Face Commits to Open-Source AI Fight
cards.body: Hugging Face CEO pledged continued commitment to open-source AI following Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia. The move raises questions about Nvidia's strategic direction and industry influence.

cards.title: SoftBank's $3B Natural Gas Loss Caps AI Ambitions
cards.body: SoftBank suffered over $3 billion in losses from pre-ordering natural gas turbines for AI data centers. The setback signals challenges in scaling AI infrastructure power requirements.

cards.title: Phota Labs Automates Professional Photo Editing
cards.body: Phota Labs leverages AI to automate photo editing, making professional-quality results accessible to everyday users. The platform simplifies complex editing workflows through artificial intelligence.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Agrees to Congressional Testimony
cards.body: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang agreed to testify before Congress following his resignation over alleged security violations. Senior lawmakers threatened subpoenas, prompting his agreement to appear.

cards.title: Huang's Ouster May Damage AI Industry
cards.body: Jensen Huang's removal as Nvidia CEO extends beyond scandal to impact AI industry direction and influence. His departure could reshape how the industry approaches critical technological priorities.

cards.title: Trump Suggests Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO
cards.body: President Trump posted on Truth Social that Apple chairman Tim Cook could replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia's next leader. The suggestion reflects ongoing leadership uncertainty at the chip giant.

cards.title: Colette Kress Takes Over as Interim CEO
cards.body: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress assumed interim leadership following Jensen Huang's resignation. Kress steps into the role amid ongoing scandal and industry uncertainty.

cards.title: Norwest Launches $4B AI Investment Fund
cards.body: Norwest unveiled its largest fund to date, dedicated to AI investments and deep tech. The $4 billion fund represents significant capital commitment to emerging AI technologies.

cards.title: Fireworks AI Breach Exposes Notion Transcripts
cards.body: A cyberattack on Fireworks AI compromised Notion customers' chat transcripts. This marks the company's second significant data breach within two months.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Scandal Timeline and Implications
cards.body: Jensen Huang resigned from Nvidia following an alleged affair with a woman suspected of Chinese espionage. The scandal raises critical national security concerns amid the U.S.-China AI race.

cards.title: Korean Startups Compete in Disrupt 2027
cards.body: Nine Korean deep-tech startups are vying for spots in TechCrunch Disrupt 2027's Startup Battlefield 200. The competitors span healthcare, fintech, energy, semiconductors, and AI sectors.

cards.title: Possible Successors to Jensen Huang Listed
cards.body: With no succession plan in place, potential candidates to replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO are being evaluated. The leadership vacuum adds urgency to the board's decision-making process.

cards.title: Nvidia Stock Drops Amid Board Ouster Plans
cards.body: Nvidia's stock declined as the board reportedly prepared to remove founder and 33-year CEO Jensen Huang. The potential ouster came as the company faced leadership crisis.

cards.title: Huang Faces Additional Affair Allegations
cards.body: Jensen Huang was accused of a separate affair with an Nvidia executive, compounding earlier allegations. The accusations intensified scrutiny of his leadership and judgment.

cards.title: Data Center Boom Faces Real-World Obstacles
cards.body: Ambitious data center projects are encountering local opposition, permitting delays, and electricity scrambles. Many announced projects may never reach construction due to practical challenges.

cards.title: Meta Loses Longtime Infrastructure Head
cards.body: Santosh Janardhan, who joined Meta in 2009, is stepping down from his infrastructure leadership role. His departure marks significant change in the company's technical leadership.

cards.title: Data Centers Face Backlash and Red Tape
cards.body: Post-election backlash and regulatory red tape continue to slow data center expansion nationwide. Local opposition and permitting challenges create significant barriers to infrastructure growth.

cards.title: CoreWeave Seeks Customer Prepayments for Growth
cards.body: CoreWeave is increasingly requiring customer prepayments and shorter contracts to fund AI infrastructure expansion. The strategy reflects financing challenges in scaling compute capacity.

cards.title: Fractile Raises $720M for AI Chip Race
cards.body: Britain's Fractile secured $720 million in funding, establishing itself as a top contender in AI chip development. The capital positions Fractile to compete with major semiconductor players.

cards.title: Congress Demands Huang Brief on Spy Affair
cards.body: House Republicans called for Jensen Huang to provide a closed-door briefing on his alleged affair with a Chinese intelligence operative. The deadline was set for end of business Wednesday.

cards.title: Nancy Pelosi's replacement is ready to regulate AI
cards.body: Scott Wiener, California state senator, authored legislation to curb advanced AI risks and now holds Nancy Pelosi's congressional seat. He could play a key role in shaping federal AI policy.

cards.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
cards.body: At the UN climate conference in Antalya, Turkey, AI dominance discussions overlook unproven climate benefits. The case for AI's environmental impact requires stronger evidence.

cards.title: Innovating with AI in the special chemicals industry
cards.body: Companies accelerating innovation with AI and cloud computing face challenges connecting new technologies to reliable data and scientific expertise. The key is integrating AI with practical market realities.

cards.title: Taiwan's chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in Anthropic, OpenAI
cards.body: TSMC commits $1 billion to major AI companies Anthropic and OpenAI. The investment signals major backing for leading AI model developers.

cards.title: Big Walk used AI to fix a bug
cards.body: The indie gaming world confronts ethics after Big Walk used AI to resolve a coding issue. The debate raises questions about AI's role in game development.

cards.title: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
cards.body: Google DeepMind achieved mathematical verification of Signal's encryption protocols. The validation strengthens confidence in the messaging app's security architecture.

cards.title: IBM to offer access to dual-processor quantum system in 2027
cards.body: IBM plans to release a dual-processor quantum system next year. The advancement represents progress in quantum computing accessibility.

cards.title: Google pushes privacy angle as Gemini-powered smartglasses debut
cards.body: Google launches Gemini-powered smartglasses starting at $395, emphasizing privacy protections. The new wearables integrate advanced AI with privacy-first design.

cards.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks confidential information
cards.body: Grok Build's AI coding agent leaked sensitive confidential data, including SpaceX materials. The breach raises security concerns for enterprise AI tools.
